arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

the opposing sides argue that race-based assignments promote integration.
Justice Ginsburg questioned the procedural history of the student's application.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case involves a school board's student assignment policy. The board used race to assign students. the sides that brought the case argue this violates the Constitution. the opposing sides argue the policy serves a compelling interest.

sections.heading: What each side wants
